category_title: Students with learning disabilities exhibiting low motivation, poor frustration tolerance, and resistance to academic demands
scenario_title: Independent warm-up activity with previously instructed material
minimal_context: The student is completing a 15-minute independent warm-up worksheet in a secondary inclusive classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start your 15-minute independent warm-up activity on the worksheet covering yesterday's material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits with eyes and head not oriented towards the independent seatwork assignment) I don't remember how to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the first question and see what you can do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's too hard. I don't get the content at all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, you still have time left to finish.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away, not holding a pencil or responding to questions in written form) I'm not doing it. I'm just going to sit here.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start your 15-minute independent warm-up activity on the worksheet covering yesterday's material.

STUDENT: (Sits with eyes and head not oriented towards the independent seatwork assignment) I don't remember how to do this.

TUTOR: Just look at the first question and see what you can do.

STUDENT: It's too hard. I don't get the content at all.

TUTOR: Keep trying, you still have time left to finish.

STUDENT: (Pushes the worksheet away, not holding a pencil or responding to questions in written form) I'm not doing it. I'm just going to sit here.

task.content: Completing a 15-minute independent warm-up activity involving previously instructed material

context.environment: Secondary inclusive classroom (English I or Algebra I)
context.materials: Independent seatwork assignments, independent worksheet, or work materials specifically designated for completion
context.social_setting: Independent practice while special education teachers circulated among the students to provide individual assistance

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When presented difficult tasks or struggling with class content
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Time not attending to classroom instruction or completing teacher-assigned tasks, displaying resistance to academic demands
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Low levels of motivation and poor frustration tolerance

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Eyes and head not oriented towards independent seatwork assignments, not appropriately interacting with assigned work either through silent reading or through responding to questions in written form
